scenes.caption: Requests: ask the agent that builds the CRM for a feature, a fix, a question or a workflow.

card.title: Asking the CRM's agent for something
card.sub: Requests: a feature, a fix, a question or a workflow, sent to the agent that builds the CRM, readable only by it.
card.foot: A made-up person, Sam Sample. In this explainer nothing is sent.

scenes.caption: Requests are real messages to the agent that builds the CRM, whichever vault you have open. Do not put contacts' details in them.
Your request is signed with this browser's key and sealed so that only the keeper can read it.
Log in first, on You: requests are signed with your browser's key. Here, Sam Sample, with the key's fingerprint hidden.
Choose the kind: a feature, a question, something wrong, a workflow or an idea. Then write what you would like.
Sign, seal and send. In this explainer nothing is sent: a request is a real message, so the capture stops here.
The keeper answers on this page, and only this browser can read the answer.
That is the CRM. Open it, and start on Today.

card.title: That is the CRM
card.sub: Today, actions, follow-ups, import, your key and your vaults, verified keys, and requests.
